info.description: Breathe is a minimalist breathing app with visual guidance to help you relax, focus, or wind down before bed.

relax.description: Equal, slow inhales and exhales create a steady rhythm that can help you relax.

focus.description: Counting the four phases directs your attention to your breath and helps you stay focused.

sleep.description: The slow 4–7–8 rhythm offers a quiet, repeatable breathing practice to help you wind down before sleep.

session.title: What do you need right now?
session.prepare: Breathe out as much as you can.
